sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for SEO Audits in Kochi

items.html: We rank findings by impact, not volume. A 40-page audit listing every minor issue helps nobody — we highlight what's actually costing you rankings first.
Real competitor data, not generic checklists. Every audit compares your site against businesses actually outranking you, not a one-size-fits-all template.
Clear, plain-English reporting. You understand exactly what's wrong and why, without needing to be an SEO expert yourself to follow the report.
The audit becomes a working roadmap. Findings translate directly into a prioritized action plan, whether you implement it yourself or work with us going forward.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — SEO Audit Services Kochi

items.q: What's included in a comprehensive SEO audit?
items.a: A full audit covers technical health, on-page structure, content quality, backlink profile, and competitor benchmarking together — not just one of these areas sold as a complete audit.

items.q: How is this different from the free website audit?
items.a: The Free SEO audit services Kochi option covers surface-level basics as an entry point. A comprehensive paid audit goes deeper into competitor analysis, backlink quality, and prioritized technical findings with a full written report.

items.q: How long does an SEO audit take to complete?
items.a: A comprehensive audit typically takes 5–7 business days from site access to full report delivery, depending on site size, page count, and content complexity.

items.q: Will the audit tell me exactly what to fix first?
items.a: Yes. Findings are prioritized by ranking impact, so you know exactly what to address first rather than facing a long list with no clear starting point.

items.q: Do you audit backlinks as part of the report?
items.a: Yes. Backlink audit services Kochi assess link quality and flag any harmful or low-value backlinks that could be holding your site back.

items.q: Can the audit be used if we're switching SEO agencies?
items.a: Yes — many clients request an audit specifically to evaluate a previous agency's work or get an independent second opinion before committing to a new one.
